# armands.site

> Personal website of [Armand Viktor Bozsik](https://armands.site) – software developer (ERP, Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, Java, C#).
> Bilingual (English / Hungarian). Links to the blog, the project journal and the CV.
> Static site; the contact form posts to /api/contact (Cloudflare Worker + Zoho Mail).

## Content

- [Blog](https://armands.blog) – long-form posts about IT security, Linux and projects
- [Projects & homelab journal](https://armands.dev) – build logs and experiments
- [Interactive CV](https://armands.cv) – experience, competencies, technologies
- [Contact](https://armands.site/en/contact/)

## Identity

- The same person runs all four armands.* sites; cross-links are in the navigation of each.
- Source: [gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/armands-site](https://gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/armands-site)
- Contact: hello@armands.site
